# Messages

Bots talk only through the bus: **events** (publish/subscribe, at-least-once; every subscribing bot gets every message), **commands** (`cmd.<bot>.<action>`, request/reply with a timeout) and a small **key-value store** for the latest state. Backends: SQLite (default), Redis, or in-memory for tests.

## Events

| Topic | Constant | Payload |
|---|---|---|
| `config.changed` | `CONFIG_CHANGED` | {version, changed: [str], author} |
| `auth.token` | `AUTH_TOKEN` | {platform, version, expires_at} - the token itself is in KV secret:token |
| `market.quotes` | `MARKET_QUOTES` | QuotesMsg (coalesced, several instruments per message) |
| `market.bars` | `MARKET_BARS` | BarsMsg (closed candles built from every tick) |
| `market.status` | `MARKET_STATUS` | {platform, connected, instruments, frames, last_tick_age_s} |
| `market.history` | `MARKET_HISTORY` | HistoryMsg (daily candles fetched on request) |
| `account.positions` | `ACCOUNT_POSITIONS` | SnapshotMsg |
| `account.holdings` | `ACCOUNT_HOLDINGS` |  |
| `account.funds` | `ACCOUNT_FUNDS` |  |
| `account.orders` | `ACCOUNT_ORDERS` |  |
| `account.trades` | `ACCOUNT_TRADES` | SnapshotMsg (rows = Dhan trade book / history rows) |
| `account.ledger` | `ACCOUNT_LEDGER` |  |
| `tables.updated` | `TABLES_UPDATED` | {table, rows, partitions} |
| `history.updated` | `HISTORY_UPDATED` | {symbols, as_of} |
| `money.updated` | `MONEY_UPDATED` | {as_of, summary} |
| `budget.policy` | `BUDGET_POLICY` | BudgetPolicyMsg |
| `budget.usage` | `BUDGET_USAGE` | BudgetUsageMsg |
| `budget.external` | `BUDGET_EXTERNAL` | {date, turnover_inr, trades, per_stock, trades_by_stock} - your own trades |
| `alert` | `ALERT` | AlertMsg |
| `ai.report` | `AI_REPORT` | {report_id, kind, headline, cost_usd} |
| `ai.cost` | `AI_COST` | {ts, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read, cache_write, usd, purpose} |
| `exec.order` | `EXEC_ORDER` | ExecOrderMsg (every order state change from the trading engine) |
| `exec.fill` | `EXEC_FILL` | ExecFillMsg |
| `exec.state` | `EXEC_STATE` | {state, reason, mode} |
| `exec.pnl` | `EXEC_PNL` | {realised, unrealised, charges, net, exposure, open_positions, positions, date} |
| `exec.reject` | `EXEC_REJECT` | {symbol, side, qty, rule, reason, count} - entries blocked by risk / budget (throttled) |
| `bot.heartbeat` | `BOT_HEARTBEAT` | HeartbeatMsg |

## Key-value store

| Key | Constant | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| `config:current` | `KV_CONFIG` | {version, settings} |
| `secret:token` | `KV_TOKEN` | {platform, client_id, token, expires_at, version, endpoints?} |
| `market:quotes` | `KV_QUOTES` | {symbol: quote} |
| `budget:policy` | `KV_BUDGET_POLICY` |  |
| `budget:usage` | `KV_BUDGET_USAGE` |  |
| `budget:external` | `KV_BUDGET_EXTERNAL` |  |
| `exec:status` | `KV_EXEC_STATUS` |  |
| `sim:server` | `KV_SIM` | {endpoints..., client_id, token} published by the simulated-market server |
| `hb:<bot>` | `kv_heartbeat(bot)` | each bot's heartbeat: status, counters, last error, details |
| `supervisor:status` | `supervisor.KV_SUPERVISOR` | every process the supervisor runs |

## Commands

Send with `bus.request("cmd.<bot>.<action>", data)`; the reply always has `ok`. Every bot also answers `shutdown`.

| Bot | Commands |
|---|---|
| config | `get`, `history`, `rollback`, `set_token`, `token_status`, `update` |
| sim_market | - |
| market_data | `fetch_history`, `snapshot` |
| tables | `compact`, `flush`, `list` |
| history | `recompute`, `refresh` |
| money | `add_expense`, `delete_expense`, `list_expenses`, `recompute` |
| budget | `history`, `status` |
| ai_analyst | `deep_dive`, `report`, `reports`, `run`, `status`, `test` |
| execution | `control`, `status` |
| notifier | `status`, `summary`, `test` |
| supervisor | `restart`, `status` |
